title: PolyProPicks Architect Mission Contract
description: Canonical machine-readable Mission Contract. The Architect states WHAT / WHY / ACCEPTANCE; registered commands and the executor own generic HOW. Compiled and semantically validated by scripts/control-plane/mission-compile.mjs — a focused dependency-free compiler, not a generic JSON Schema engine.

mission.description: WHAT is being changed, in one or two sentences. Never a procedure.

business_result.description: WHY — the value this mission delivers once terminal acceptance holds.

executor.description: Routing metadata. Resolvable at runtime; never invented.

risk_class.description: Risk controls authority, safety and reviewer requirement. Risk NEVER injects a technical capability.

hard_boundaries.description: Genuine boundaries only. A recoverable condition (dirty root, missing dependencies, generated drift, existing PR, CI/deployment wait, reviewer polling, state reconciliation, implementation correction, transport interruption) may never be declared here.

evaluated_at.description: START_GATE criteria must hold before execution. TERMINAL criteria are measured after execution — 'not yet implemented' at task start is NOT a failed criterion.

direct_actions.description: Actions the SELECTED EXECUTOR itself performs. A downstream consequence in another system is not a direct action and creates no capability requirement.

persistence.description: APPLICATION_OWNED persistence is the application writing through its own code path. It is NOT raw database mutation and must NOT require DATABASE_WRITE.

required_capabilities.description: Every entry MUST name the direct action that requires it. No direct_action_ref → semantic validation FAIL.

commands.description: Registered command IDs. Each must have a registration, an executable binding, and be invokable by the selected executor.

modules.description: Conditional sections, emitted ONLY when directly relevant.

authorization_ref.description: Optional. Named Founder decision id when the mission touches protected scope.

runtime_evidence_requirement.description: Optional. Named live evidence the terminal result must carry.

x-invariants: CAPABILITY_BY_DIRECT_ACTION_ONLY — every required capability resolves to a direct action that declares it.
RISK_NOT_CAPABILITY — risk class controls authority, safety and reviewers; it never injects a technical capability.
APPLICATION_PERSISTENCE_NOT_RAW_DB_MUTATION — APPLICATION_OWNED persistence must not require DATABASE_WRITE.
ONE_REPOSITORY_BOUNDARY — every direct action shares the mission repository boundary; foreign-repository capabilities are rejected.
REGISTERED_COMMAND_VALIDITY — registration + executable binding + executor invocability, all three.
RECOVERY_BEFORE_BLOCK — a canonically recoverable condition may never be declared a hard boundary.
INCOMPLETE_IS_NOT_TERMINAL — unfinished implementation never justifies a terminal block.
SESSION_END_IS_TRANSPORT_RESUME — execution-slice exhaustion is transport state, not a business block.
ACCEPTANCE_AFTER_EXECUTION — TERMINAL acceptance criteria are never evaluated at the START GATE.
NO_MANUAL_ORCHESTRATION — lifecycle mechanics owned by registered commands may not be restated as mission prose.
